edges.label: supports
edges.reason: Both quotes report approximately 130 million names deleted/dropped from electoral rolls. The NEW quote cites activists' compilation of official data, while the EXISTING quote cites the Indian Express.

edges.sentence: On 2026-09-08, The Guardian reported “So far, about 130 million names have been dropped from draft rolls in 30 states and union territories, the Indian Express reported.”; on 2026-10-06, The Wall Street Journal reported “Since then, some 130 million names have been deleted from final or preliminary electoral rolls, according to tallies from official data compiled by activists.”.
